metadata.baseline_definition: Historical exclusion CONFIG on the current rebuilt radar/gate code; not the old entire binary.
metadata.reason_semantics: reason is latest actual latched warning; initial_stop_reason is the first observed new dynamic/merged event where available; neither is physical braking latency.
metadata.note: Static synthetic ground-segmented raw PointCloud2 and ideal-cone scalar ranges into actual native nodes/gates; not CARLA, real radar detection, or physical braking.
